title: Nightward
shortDescription: Build one defence. Hold the canal for 40 escalating waves.
description:
Keep a lantern-lit canal city standing through one continuous 40-wave siege. Place towers around the bends, choose their specialisations and combine damage, slowing and sight to stop armoured convoys and hidden fleets.

Your towers, upgrades, glow and remaining light carry through five acts. Time a keeper command to ignite a crowd, interrupt a boss or strike through armour. Defeat five bosses and watch the Night Market, Canal Observatory and Waterfront Gardens come back to life.

Start with Sol, then try Mira and Ivo from the campaign menu. Pause whenever you need to plan. Your defence saves automatically on this browser, and Standard and Gentle modes offer free retries from act starts and before each boss. Short expeditions and encounter practice are also available.
controls: Mouse or touch: use Build Spark to place the first tower and start wave 1. Select later plots, preview a tower and confirm its placement. Select towers to upgrade. Pause to plan. Keyboard: P pauses or resumes; Q activates your charged keeper command; Escape closes a panel; Tab moves between controls. All gameplay actions have on-screen controls.
advertising: Disabled; no ad providers, rewarded-ad buttons or purchases in this build.
sdk: Not integrated. Optional for Basic Launch; platform KPI collection is automatic.
saveBehaviour: Local browser saves with a previous-save backup, act checkpoints and pre-boss checkpoints. Published saves retain their original rules. No account login or cloud sync in Basic Launch.
externalRequests: None made by the game build.
developerNotes: New profiles enter the continuous 40-wave campaign directly as Sol on Standard. Existing campaigns restore paused. Optional on-board counter previews use actual coverage and normal prices. Preparation undo and one free early Standard/Gentle move allow experimentation. Reports aggregate light lost across the wave and recommend only legal, affordable purchases at retries. Compact enemy silhouettes, shared boss-state labels and earned restoration beats improve combat readability and payoff. Published siege1 campaigns preserve their original rules. No custom fullscreen control, cross-promotion, ads, SDK, purchases or external game requests. The archive is 0.30 MB. See CRAZYGAMES-RESUBMISSION.md and the release reports for scoped validation. Human playtests, physical devices, audio listening and hosted publisher QA remain pending.
publishingRecommendation: Non-exclusive. Existing public GitHub Pages version remains available. Do not opt into exclusivity without reviewing the existing distribution.
